reviews.text: Dean is an amazing trainer. He taught my wife and equally as much as he taught our dog Ellie.   We highly recommend Dean to come into your home to creates beater experience for you and your dog.

Dean was really great to work with.  He came to our home and gave us a lot of helpful tips for working with our Pyr puppy.  He was very patient with the humans, both parents and kids alike. We would love to work with him again and recommend him for families with kids and dogs of all ages.

We had such a great experience! I loved that he came directly to our home and not only worked with our dog, but also took the time to teach me how to continue the training on my own. He was so patient, kind, and sweet with our dog, and you can tell he genuinely cares about the dogs he works with. We’ve already seen such a difference, and I feel so much more confident knowing how to properly work with our dog moving forward. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a great dog trainer!

I learned about Dean and his work through someone I know, and now I’d like to recommend him as well! His training helped my boy Memo realize how smart he is, but also taught me a lot in the process. Through the 4 sessions he had, I bonded lots with my boy and learned positive ways to train. Of course, you get what you put in so that meant practice and lots of patience! I can’t thank Dean enough for working with us.
We had the best time working with Double D! He was fun and professional. My sweet dog loved Double D!

I worked with Dean at Double D Dog Training to train my 6‑month‑old cattle dog puppy, and the experience was outstanding. Dean introduced essential commands like sit, wait, stay, and leave it, and my puppy picked them up quickly thanks to his clear, effective teaching style.

He made every session fun, educational, and easy to follow, breaking down each step so we could confidently continue practicing at home. Dean has helped us immensely in getting our puppy started on the right path at an early age.

I highly recommend Double D Dog Training for dog owners of all ages and experience. Dean is truly is master at his craft

Dean was amazing and we found him after a friend referral.  He helped us significantly with teaching our dog basic commands, patience, and how to use rewards to train him and keep him engaged/mentally challenged.  Oliver always looked forward to his sessions and had a good nap after.  He got the entire family involved and gave us tools to keep working with him between sessions and after graduation. We are grateful for Dean's positivity and kindness and highly recommend his classes.

Dean is awesome.  He started working with our Goldendoodle, Newman, when he was 11 weeks old.   We had our last of four session with Dean today and the transformation over that time has been fantastic.  Newman now sits, lays down, shake, gives hi fives, stays on command and wait until given the release to come to his food bowl when we feed him.  Granted he is not perfect, after all he is still a 16 week old puppy, but Dean has given us lots of tools to continue working with Newman.  I highly recommend Dean to anyone looking to make there pup a well mannered member of the family.
Dean did a fantastic job with Penny! He seems to have some magic skill to get dogs to behave!

Highly recommend Double D Dog Training! They helped me build a solid training foundation with my dog, Kairi, and gave me the tools and confidence to continue her training on my own. I’ve already seen a huge improvement in her behavior, and I’m excited to keep building on everything we learned.

Dean did a wonderful job helping us train our 9 month old Cavapoo named Cashew while also guiding us through the unique challenges of working with our senior dog, Tillie, who recently experienced sudden vision loss.

He helped us establish healthy boundaries with our puppy while also building Tillie’s confidence in our home during such a big transition. His patience, knowledge, and personalized approach have been invaluable to our family.

We highly recommend Dean to anyone looking for a dog trainer. We couldn’t be more grateful for his help!

Dean was great to work with. He was patient, knowledgeable, and always took the time to answer my questions and explain what we were working on. He made the training easy to understand and gave me practical tips to keep practicing at home.
I noticed a big improvement in my dog's behavior and confidence, and I feel much more confident handling different situations now too. It was clear that Dean genuinely cared about helping both me and my dog succeed.
I would definitely recommend Dean to anyone looking for a dog trainer. It was a really positive experience, and I'm grateful for all of his help.

Choosing Double D Dog Training was a great choice. Dean helped us navigate our daily walks and also helped make us comfortable taking our dogs to public environments, such as the mall. Dean was prompt with the appointments and hands-on in the training sessions.  We would definitely use Dean again and recommend his services.

When I reached out to Dean, I was met with confidence and reassurance that he could help me learn to manage my 85lb, 2 year old dog’s behavior. Dean provided knowledgeable instruction to help my family and I support and train our dog, Leo, who was a rescue. In less than a month, we have eliminated unwanted destructive behaviors, jumping, and  pulling on the leash. I was shocked how quickly our dog made progress following Dean’s training program. We noticed immediate improvement. Dean has made life at home with Leo much more enjoyable and helped us see what a wonderful dog we have. I would highly recommend Dean’s training to anyone who feels stuck and needs help managing their dog’s behavior.

I seriously can’t recommend Dean at Double D Dog Training enough!
I’ve been around dogs my entire life, but I’d never had a puppy of my own. At first, I was completely overwhelmed. I was so used to older dogs listening, not a puppy looking me dead in the eyes while continuing to chew up everything in sight!
From the first phone call with Dean, I had a feeling he was the right person to help us. He made the entire process so much less stressful and was always patient, knowledgeable, encouraging, and easy to learn from.
Freya, my almost 4-month-old Golden Retriever, has already come such a long way. I feel so much more confident working with her because of everything Dean has taught us. The training was easy to follow, it actually worked, and it made learning fun for both of us.
If you’re looking for someone who truly understands dogs and genuinely cares about helping both you and your pup succeed, Double D Dog Training is the only way to go. I couldn’t be more grateful for everything Dean has done for us!

Double D was absolutely fantastic! We brought our puppy in as first-time dog owners, and from day one he was great—calm, patient, and really understanding of what our puppy needed to learn.

He didn’t just teach us how to train, he taught our puppy quickly and confidently. In a short time (around 11 commands), our little guy was already picking things up fast and responding much better day by day.

What we appreciated most was the extra effort he put into helping *us* too. We got tons of helpful tips and tricks for day-to-day routines, communication, and how to navigate common puppy challenges as beginners. We never felt overwhelmed—just supported and guided.

If you’re looking for a dog training service that’s effective, friendly, and great for both puppies and owners, we highly recommend Double D!

Working with Dean was such a wonderful experience! His method of positive reinforcement training was just what Eben, our little golden retriever puppy, needed to learn his basic puppy manners. Dean was always easy to communicate with, timely for our appointments and did a fabulous job of involving our five year old daughter in our training sessions. I would highly recommend Double D to anyone seeking upbeat, positive reinforcement training for their pup! Thanks Dean!!

Dean was a great help and resource for us when looking to train a rambunctious lab puppy. In four weeks we have a much more manageable dog, and we feel more confident in how redirect unwanted behaviors. My puppy has also enjoyed the positive reinforcement and the chance to be a good student. We had a great experience and I highly recommend Double D Dig Training.

Dean is a magician. We got a lab puppy and needed training, especially since we have 2 toddlers. I was so worried 4 sessions wouldn’t do much, but after 5 minutes into the first session, he had her sitting on command. I’m not exaggerating. He knows what he’s doing. I just wish he could train toddlers and husbands too 🤣
Such a great experience training with Dean! Our dog loved him and we learned a lot!!

Dean did a fabulous job training my rescue pup Lily.  She is very tentative and does not trust.  However she warmed up to him very quickly.  He was patient and loving 🥰
I highly recommend his services 👍

Dean was fantastic with our dogs  He has a very calming demeanor, with both owners and animals  He is very positive through the whole process  Something very important to us  He was always on time and keep communication open through the week
He kept each training fresh and always left us with knowledge we didn’t have before   He is a wealth of knowledge and information
Very happy for us and our dogs we found him

We have a two year old miniature Aussie and needed a trainer. Double D was the company recommended to us and Dean is the owner/trainer. No dog will be trained completely after the program but our dog is not the same as before we started. What Dean gave us was a great foundation to build on and that is our goal. Thank you Dean!

Dean was terrific with our dog Layla! We recently got a field golden retriever puppy and through the 4 session we noticed a huge improvement with her commands as well as her leash training! If you have a puppy at around 8 weeks I highly recommend Dean! 😄

Dean did a wonderful job working with our new puppy Dolly. His method of positive reinforcement is great to get the dog to want to learn. Dolly is much more confident and knows what is expected of her now. She wants to please and is much better behaved after working with Double D.

I was referred to Dean for dog training, as I needed help with my overly reactive and anxiety ridden dog on walks. Dean came to my home for 4 sessions and taught me how to manage my dog Tater with positive reinforcement. Tater learned how to sit, look at me, wait, stay, and shake. Dean also helped me on walks with Tater and he no longer spins, lunges, and barks at cars or other dogs. Taters behavior has changed so much and I am grateful!

Hired Dean to leash train my foster dog; who will be leaving on transport. Dean is on time, talented, and results driven. He provided many helpful hints,  My girl is confident and ready to join her new family in the Pacific Northwest!

Dean was terrific.  He was very knowledgeable, and helped my husband and I with training just as much as Domino.  She is a young Siberian Husky who magically followed and learned all his commands quickly.  You can tell he loves what he does and the dogs love him right back.  It is amazing how well-behaved she is now, with just 4 weeks of training.  Excellent!

Dean was so great with our fur babies. We didn’t know what to expect as we were training TWO Aussies; but he made it very manageable and exciting. The dogs absolutely love him. We questioned how well positive reinforcement would work for them, but Dean successfully transformed them into better mannered dogs. In 4 short weeks, we saw steady progress each week as we built on previously learned commands. He made the training feel like playtime, not work. We are so glad we chose Double D Dog Training.

We had a great experience working with Dean! He is extremely knowledgeable and very patient, which was exactly what our energetic puppy, Silas, needed. Silas responded really well to his incentive-based training methods and was always excited to see Dean at each visit. Dean also did a wonderful job explaining how the training works so I could continue practicing with Silas at home and build on the skills he was learning. We saw great progress and truly appreciated Dean’s guidance. I would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a thoughtful and effective dog trainer.🐾

We just wrapped up our puppy training with Dean today, and I must say it was a great experience. We have a 17 week old Maltipoo and Dean not only guided my husband and I on how to train her, he included our 2 children (7 and 11 yr olds) in the process. Our pup Cincy did great! We are so pleased with what she learned and what Dean taught us and how we will continue to in implement it daily. Thank you Dean!

Dean was outstanding with our 3 month old Cavapoo. He introduced him to several new commands and then gave my wife and I the teaching/tools we needed to reinforce the behavior and build a great foundation. Our puppy took extremely well to the teaching as well as Dean and we always enjoyed our training sessions. Dean was professional, energetic, organized, and an all around pleasure to work with. We would recommend him to anyone!

Dean is a natural with dogs. He has so many good tips, ideas, and advice that help with energetic puppies! Our dog loved having him here and is so much better behaved already. We highly recommend Double D for any training needs you might have.

Our whole family had a great experience with Dean at Double D! He taught us so much and we now have confidence in making sure our new pup is obedient and safe. Our kids will also now have life long skills when it comes to dog training. Thank you Dean!

Double D Dog Training is the best trainer out there! Dean is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate in what he does. His expertise shows in every training session and our puppy Bentley is doing AMAZING! Bentley learned all the commands/behaviors Dean listed in his puppy obedience training and graduated today with great success (and lots of tail wags)!
Dean is amazing! My Bassett Hound adored him. Bassets can be very stubborn. We graduated today from puppy dog training. Basic commands. She passed with flying colors. Highly recommend Dean!

We had a great experience with Dean, who came to our home to work with Mabel. He was patient, professional, and clearly experienced. Mabel responded so well to his approach, and we noticed real improvements in her confidence and behavior. We’re grateful for his help and highly recommend Dean to anyone looking for exceptional training.

Dean is an excellent dog trainer. From Day 1 our English Cocker Spaniel, Nutmeg, reacted positively to Dean's easy, positive-reinforcement manner. He carefully prepares each lesson and ensures that the dog owners get as much training as the puppy.  Dean leaves a review worksheet after each lesson, so daily practice is easy and fun. Finally, he follows up each lesson with a check-in to make sure the practices are going well and to make sure there are no questions.  Dean is top-notch and I would be very happy to recommend him to anyone.

I finally decided to do something about my eight year-old dog’s leash aggression because I was tired of being embarrassed every time we passed another dog during our daily walks. Dean gave me the tools to reinforce redirecting during our walks and now our walks are much calmer and more enjoyable. You definitely can teach an old dog new tricks!

Dean is phenomenal!!!  This was our 2nd dog to be trained with him. My sweet boy Rolo had a rough start in life, so he was afraid of everything and everyone. After Dean’s help Rolo has made new friends and learned so much!!  It’s truly incredible. He’s like a different dog. I just love the calming effect Dean has on dogs AND on me. His training techniques are superb and he is one of the kindest people I’ve ever met. All 3 of my dogs (and my whole family) love Dean!
Dean did a great job working with my beagle!

Dean is fantastic and really helped my little Daisy grow more confident and also helped me learn how to be a better dog mom. It’s been day and night from when she first started. Daisy absolutely loves him and he has really established a great relationship with me and Daisy.

I started working with Dean 2 days after we brought Olive home.  His methods and training were clear and helpful. We have achieved so much in 4 weeks and we have a great basis for further training.  But more than anything I have appreciated his experience and guidance in helping her to settle into our home and life - it has truly been invaluable.  I’m sure we will work with Dean again in the future and highly recommend him.

Dean from Double D Dog Training was wonderful to work with.   My husband and I love that he came to our home.  He is clear with instructions and patient.   He taught our Stanley the basic commands, which helps with his behavior and safety.   Stanley was definitely excited to see Dean each week and his treats. We plan to take the knowledge he gave us and work with our older dog.

If you want results with training, I highly recommend Dean.   He was great to work with and very professional.

My doggo Dixie, was so energetic and boisterous, I couldn’t even walk her on leash outside. She would tie my feet up or pull me over…25lbs on the end of leash can do some injury.
Dean with Double D Dog Training came to my house and not only trained Dixie (terrier) but Hershey (Chihuahua) picked up some lessons too. He helped me learn how to drain Dixie’s energy with games and toys. Focus her when she would get distracted. And made it all fun and informative.
I highly, highly recommend Dean and Double D Dog Training for your doggos.

Our Miss Sadie just graduated from Double D Training and we couldn’t be happier.  She came to us a timid, anxious, shy dog and within 4 weeks Dean was able to get her walking on lead, learning and understanding sit, wait, come, lay down, drop and leave it.  It was so enjoyable watching her learn.  She will stay on her mat while I go the the front door and collect packages or great guests.  She watches me to hear “come” before moving.  All thus in 4 weeks - amazing.  And, Dean is a really nice person!

I would highly recommend Double D training. He was great to work with personally and sis great with kids and dog. He gave my kids great confidence in training and ultimately improved their relationship. Overall he was great with everyone and dog. Definitely recommend!

Dean did an outstanding job of helping us train our wonderful dog Roxy. More importantly, as a result of his amazing expertise and instruction methods, we not only established a stronger bond with Roxy, but also a great foundation for further learning.  Dean is a great dog trainer and well worth the price.

I can't recommend Double D Training enough! From the very first session, the professionalism was evident. Each training was structured and effective. What really stood out was the detailed notes and documents provided after every session — super helpful for continuing the training at home and tracking progress.

Between sessions, Dean was always available to answer any questions I had, which made the whole experience feel incredibly supportive. Not only is Dean amazing with dogs, but also a fantastic teacher for humans — explaining techniques clearly and making sure I felt confident in applying them.

If you're looking for someone who truly cares, communicates well, and gets results, this is the trainer to go with!
Outstanding training provided by an outstanding trainer.  Dean helped us to achieve the results we were looking for.

We had a great experience with Double D Dog Training! Dean was very helpful and used positive reinforcement and rewards to train our puppy, Luna. He was always accessible to answer questions, share insights, and provide clear instruction (even between sessions). Double D was recommended to us, and based on our experience we would definitely recommend Dean to anyone looking for a great dog trainer!

After being urged by family, my husband and I knew it was time to hire a professional dog trainer for our 5-year-old dog Jax. I was anxious about training and interviewed multiple trainers, unsure if my dog was even trainable. I can honestly say I am SO glad I ended up choosing Dean as our dog trainer! Dean is incredibly kind, funny, knowledgeable, and professional. He really takes his time to support his clients (both human and doggy!), which made a world of difference in the training process. I am beyond impressed by how my dog's behavior has improved in just four sessions, and so is my family. Dean also helped my pup and me strengthen our relationship through loving structure, trust, and respect. I was worried that Dean wouldn't be able to handle my dog... but wow... Dean and my pup really blew me away! I am so grateful for Dean, and my pup and I will be sad that our weekly trainings are over. However, the skills we learned will last a lifetime. If you want a trainer for your puppy or grown dog, save yourself the time searching and choose Dean. He has 5 stars for a reason. You will not be disappointed. THANK YOU DEAN!

Dean helped train my 6 month old Golden Retriever, Shiner. After training Shiner is a completely different dog. Dean was so helpful throughout our trainings and is always so willing to answer any questions or give any tips. He gave us all the tips and tools that we never would have thought of and it has drastically paid off. I couldn't recommend Dean more, and we will continue to have training sessions with him.

What a difference, Dean made in training my golden doodle puppy, Barley!
It was an absolute pleasure working with Dean, he was beyond patient with Barley, my 10yr wolfhound, Sinead and myself! The one on one, in home training with positive reinforcement that Dean provides is without a doubt the right option. You and your dog will benefit from Dean's knowledge and expertise!
We loved working with Dean!  We learned a lot from him that has helped us get a handle on our golden retriever pup, Violet.  Dean was super easy and a pleasure to work with.

Dean from Double D was fabulous!! He was so patient with our puppy, Libby and our older dog, Macy. Dean was so clear with his instructions and how he modeled the tasks for us to learn. It was simple and fun! We signed up for the puppy obedience class, but I feel like we learned so much more. Dean answered any and all questions and checked in frequently. I highly recommend Dean and Double D Dog Training.

Dean at Double D Dog Training was fantastic to work with. From the beginning, he was very transparent and even recommended a colleague—whom we’d actually trained with before—because she was closer to us. That honesty really stood out and showed that he had our best interests in mind. Ultimately, I appreciated his patience in answering all my questions and his straightforward approach to fees and the training program, so I decided to move forward with him.

My pup already knew the basics and a few tricks, but I was looking for help with her excitement around people—especially jumping, barking, and her anxiety around other dogs and loud sounds. At our first session, she surprised me by growling and barking at Dean, which is unusual for her. But with each session, we saw clear improvement.

Dean gave me practical feedback on how to engage with her, how to play and walk with her more intentionally, and how to help her greet strangers calmly. After our final session today at the dog park, I was so proud to see her more confident, not startled by loud noises, and still responsive to my commands—even with distractions.

Thanks to Dean, I feel more confident taking her around my sobrinos and bringing her with me more places. I highly recommend Double D Dog Training for anyone looking for a trainer who’s honest, knowledgeable, and truly cares about helping both you and your dog succeed.

My 8 year old daughter and I recently got our first puppy together and I wanted her to take ownership of the training. If you have kids, you probably know that they often listen better to other people than their own parents.  I hired Dean for this specific purpose of engaging my daughter and he did a fantastic job working with her and keeping her focused on the training and how important it is to raise a dog properly. He was very patient and kind but also knew when to be very direct on important matters so that my daughter would understand how big of a responsibility she has in how he behaves and develops. Dean was always on time and flexible with the specific scheduling requirements that we needed. Below is a picture of our 4 month old puppy in my daughter’s lap at the dentist showing how well behaved he is around people, even during events he has never been to before. Dean’s concepts and training methods work! If you are looking for a great dog trainer to help you get started out, I would highly recommend Dean!

Dean did a great job of training my pup Sadie and me. I include myself, because so much of the training was tweaking my responses and learning ways to redirect my dog.  Having someone come to the house really helped with issues I don’t believe could have been addressed in a store or by being sent away for two weeks. Barking and jumping against the fence (and over the fence) has been dramatically reduced. Walking in the neighborhood with dozens of deer and other dogs was challenging. Now, I look forward to our walks. The “touch” command has been priceless!   I highly recommend Dean and his methods of training.

We had an excellent experience with Dean!  He explained the program clearly, left great instructions and brought all the tools needed.  We got some great ideas to keep our large breed dog busy and mentally stimulated.  Dean also did a great job working with my daughter who is the dogs primary care giver.

We bought 2 puppies and needed some help establishing good habits for ALL of us. We learned just as much as our puppies. Dean was so patient and it is very apparent that he loves what he does. We had fun and looked forward to our sessions.

Dean and Double D is awesome!  He trained our Ausie 4 years ago and she was thrilled to remember him when he came to train our new rescue terrier.  His enthusiasm is contagious. The dogs are excited to follow his commands.  Dean shows us how to keep the training up.  He is a real 5 star “dog whisperer.”   And we are so lucky to have had him twice!!
We couldn't be happier to recommend Double D Dog Training. Dean was extremely patient, professional, and punctual. His guidance was invaluable.

Double D Dog training was wonderful for our wild puppy. He should us just how smart she is and can be a great dog. Dean has really helped our family because we were really struggling with our sweet, but full of energy puppy!!

Who says old dogs cannot learn new tricks? Hire Dean!  We have two ( 11yrs and 9yrs old ) Dachshunds that had never had formal training.  Our girls performed like rock stars and we were able to break some bad habits, after all these years!  We are so grateful to have found Dean! Dean is truly a dog whisperer!

Dean Duet did an excellent job training us and our 5- month-old Berma Doodle! He was well prepared, gave us appropriate and easy -to-understand instructions and clearly loves what he does. Dean exceeded expectations. We are continuing our training and making great progress, following Dean’s protocol. Dean is an outstanding instructor and his fees are very reasonable! Give him a call!!

I can’t say enough good things about Dean and Double D Dog Training! We’ve had just two sessions so far, and the difference in my puppy’s behavior is incredible.

Dean has a calm, confident presence that immediately put both me and my pup at ease. He doesn’t just train your dog—he teaches you how to communicate effectively, which makes all the difference. One of the first things we worked on was the “touch” command, and I honestly didn’t expect it to work so quickly. But just a few days after learning it, my puppy darted out the front door. My heart dropped—but I called out “touch,” and she stopped in her tracks, turned around, and came straight back to me! I was stunned. That one moment alone made the training worth it.

Dean is clearly passionate about what he does and tailors his approach to each dog’s needs and personality. I’m really looking forward to the rest of our sessions. Highly recommend Double D Dog Training to anyone looking to build a better bond with their dog.
Dean was great with our Boxer mix, Daisy! He is great to spend time explaining and answering all of our questions. I highly recommend him!

We did a lot of research and called a lot of different people to find the perfect trainer. Dean was definitely the right pick. He is very nice, professional, patient, and has a great sense of humor. He’s very comfortable to be around and makes the training process a great experience for everyone. He turned my timid, scared dog into a confident one. He is easy to contact and has great communication about appointments and updates. I highly recommend his services.

We had a great experience working with Dean for our 7-month-old corgi, Appa. Dean helped Appa learn all the basics of obedience training—sit, stay, down, drop it, and more. He was incredibly patient, knowledgeable, and really took the time to make sure we understood how to reinforce the training at home. Appa responded so well to Dean’s calm and consistent approach, and we’ve seen a huge improvement in his behavior. Highly recommend Dean to anyone looking for a reliable and effective dog trainer!

Not only is Dean a master at his craft, you can tell he loves what he does. The whole family would be so excited when he would arrive for our weekly training session. Even our old diabetic dog who isn’t allowed treats still wanted love from Dean! He was a phenomenal trainer for our puppy, but more importantly my husband and I so we could easily learn the skills needed long after training ended. He was a joy to be around and our puppy learned the necessary commands quite quickly. We picked up our 4 yr old early from school so she could be there for our last session and he was the absolute best helping her learn and participate. He bought adorable presents for our pup at “graduation”, but also our other dog and daughter. It was so sweet and thoughtful. Dean is the absolute best and we’re going to miss him now that training is finished!!

Dean is an expert with dogs!  If you are looking for someone who can connect with your dog and train both the puppy and you, Dean is the person to call.  He is professional and personable. I could really tell he cares about the animals and the outcome of the training. We did a 4 week training course and learned not only useful commands, but the importance of keeping my pet mentally stimulated with games, puzzles and toys. I can’t say enough about my positive experience with Dean and Double D Dog Training.

Dean came and worked with our 5 month old Bernie doodle. We were so surprised how well our pup did. Dean was always very communicative during and in between appointments. He is extremely knowledgeable, and has a talent for teaching both dog and owner. I am 100% satisfied with the training we received and I am sad that it has come to an end for these 4 weeks.  I highly recommend working with Dean. You will not be disappointed!!!!

Dean trained my 4 month old Lab puppy, Charlie, who was soooo bad before we got Dean.  Thank goodness I found him.  He trained us both on commands and good dog behavior.  With the four classes along with Charlie and I doing our daily homework sessions, Charlie has mastered the commands and is anxious to learn.  Dean was very good with Charlie and Charlie took to him immediately.  Dean's training methods are simple and easy for Charlie to learn.  I am so grateful that I found Dean and Charlie is such a better boy now.  Thanks again Dean!

Dean was an invaluable help with acclimating our sweet street dog Sammy to our home. He gave us great tips on how to help her relax at home with her new buddy, Jack. The handouts he provided gave us clear cut strategies to help with sitting, staying, and various other commands. Our walks are now less stressful for her and us. Her skittishness is slowly going away and she is less fearful. I would definitely recommend Dean and his services to all!

We started working with Dean after adopting a 9 month old Golden Retriever. Bringing a new dog home made it more apparent that our 3 year old Schnoodle needed some obedience training. We didn’t want our new puppy learning bad habits so we quickly reached out to Dean to begin our in-home training. Our 3 year old is very scared around strangers so having Dean come to our home helped her to be more at ease. Dean was very patient with our Daisy and by lesson 4 we all noticed a big change in her. Both girls seemed to enjoy their sessions and we will continue working with them utilizing the tools Dean provided. Each session Dean brought new games, toys or treats to try keeping the girls engaged. By our last lesson they were both waiting to see what was in his bag 😁

We would definitely recommend Dean!
Dean was a phenomenal trainer. We loved that he had our kids involved throughout the process. Not only is our pup well prepared but our kids have grown in their confidence with handling our pup.

Dean is an excellent trainer! Our 8 month old pup loved working with him. Dean has a very calm aura that helped keep our pup as calm as possible. He even offered to meet us at the dog park one session so we could see how pup did. I would recommend Dean to every dog owner!

We were referred to Dean (DoubleD) to help train our 11 month old Boxer, Rusty. In 4 sessions, he taught us 9 commands. Graduation was on the fourth session and Rusty got an A+. The humans didn't do as well. Dean is fabulous, very skilled, and has the perfect personality to help train the humans while training their dogs. We highly recommend Double D.
Working with Dean was a joy.  He works so well with your dog and shares tips on how you can do better . And makes it fun !!*****
Dean was wonderful with my Lhasa Apso, Riley.  He taught me how to work with her and taught me how to communicate with her.

Double D Dog Training was fantastic!! Dean was a great trainer and worked well with our family of 5. His techniques helped our family be consistent and unified in training our dog. Dean’s techniques have helped us so much. Dean was wonderful, he listened to our concerns, coached our children and our beagle loved him! We enjoyed the training sessions and saw a huge improvement with our dog. If you are looking for a dog trainer, Double D Dog Training will work for you. Recommend him to anybody looking to train their dog!!

After losing our Jack Russell of 17 years, we decided to get back in the game and welcome a Jack Russell puppy into our lives. We received her at nine weeks old and Dean started with her at 10 weeks. She immediately took to his training and showed discipline far more advanced than her age. She now responds to “touch”and other commands as we have four horses and she needs to be disciplined around them. Dean is very compassionate, understanding, and an excellent trainer with dogs of all ages. We were concerned about getting a puppy at our age, but what a blessing every day and Dean has enhanced that experience. We highly recommend Dean and couldn’t be more happy with the results he has produced.

We hired Dean to work with our first dog and loved his training so much we used him again for our new puppy!
